clips.title: The story
paras: At Lushwater Oasis, Hezrul Bloodmark leads the Kolkar centaur in the Barrens. His head is carried to Regthar Deathgate west of the Crossroads as proof their chieftain has fallen.

Hezrul Bloodmark leads his Kolkar centaur clan from Lushwater Oasis, south of the Crossroads. The Kolkar hold the Barrens' oases and threaten Horde supply routes and young settlements. Regthar Deathgate, an orc veteran charged with securing the land west of the Crossroads, sees their fierce rage but little discipline. He demands Hezrul's severed head to break the clan's command and throw its surviving fighters into disarray, weakening their attacks on the Horde.
